items.name: FTC — AI Consumer Protection
items.description: FTC enforcement and guidance on AI under Section 5 of the FTC Act, including the proposed policy statement on suppressing AI output accuracy, 91 FR 41638 (July 7, 2026)

titles.text: Consumer protection in the AI context

requirements.text: The FTC enforces existing consumer protection law, Section 5 of the FTC Act, against deceptive or unfair AI practices, including misrepresentation of what an AI system can do.
requirements.rationale: Claims about AI performance are subject to the same substantiation doctrine as any other ad claim.

controls.description: Substantiate AI capability claims with evidence held before publication and reviewed for implied claims.
Correct or withdraw claims whose supporting evidence no longer matches system behaviour.

requirements.text: Deliberately suppressing the accuracy of AI outputs to gain a competitive advantage - the conduct described in the Commission's proposed policy statement - risks unfair-methods-of-competition liability, alongside guidance on fairness, transparency and human oversight in AI-driven decisions.
requirements.rationale: Accuracy-suppression choices become evidence in an unfair-methods case; a record is the defence.

controls.description: Document decisions that alter AI output accuracy and the business reasons behind them.
